Simple app, nice features, very easy to follow through with. You can only make three Habits at a time without paying, and yall have LOST your minds if you think I’m about to pay $99 for such basic functionality.

My favorite feature is that you can mark a “null” day, which doesn’t add to OR interrupt a streak. It’s nice for when one of my goals wasn’t possible that day, but I don’t want to let go of my streak. Having this in-between makes it so I never feel the need to lie (which is a quick way to lose motivation).

The visual feedback of marking a completed a habit is nice, especially with the bright colors. Your phone also makes a nice *click* vibration which I like. 
You can also view statistics for how often you follow through with your goals. No ads, and an account isn’t required, which is always a plus.

Overall, very satisfied

My ADHD brain gets too distracted, I desperately wanted simplicity. After years, I’ve developed some great habits simply by using timers and reading Atomic Habits, which this app draws some concepts from. Now, I want to visualize this in a simple, easy-understand-visual for novice data folks like my wife or friends. So I turned to this app, (shout out r/dataisbeautiful). This app does just that. With intention and time, I’m excited to see what my visual will look like. Literally 3 click options:

-Did you do it? Tap.
-Did you do some of it? Tap. Tap.
-Didn’t do it? Tap. Tap. Tap.

Obviously, there are things to fill out. But compared to others, IMO, set up is simple. Reminder options are available. There is even an option for breaking habits! 

Free to use, so I’ve testing with 3 habits and I’m very happy so far. It’s only 1/2, but so far, so good. 

Some improvements for this app, for me, would just be customizable user preferences. Specifically, visuals with fonts. I have unique reading needs so the ability to alter these helps a ton! This would help keep the app accessible for all. TY for your great app.

reviews.text: I use this app every day. A couple asks for the dev…. I love this app. I use it every single day multiple times a day and have for years now. I have a large widget of everything I’m tracking on my home page and people who are looking at my screen with me always - always! - ask what the app is because the cascading colors look so cool. This app has helped me better my mental health and executive function and also is just fun to use. I’m tracking 21 habits now. A couple asks for the developer: I would love very much to have the option to enter a hex code to further customize the colors of all my habits. I will pay for this feature!! It would be really aesthetically pleasing to get more specific with the habit colors, either fully customizable RGB or just a broader color palette would be great. I’d also love to see the total number of weeks for which I’ve tracked a habit and I’d like to be able to zoom out to see all my habits in one screen, even if they’re really small bc I’m tracking a bunch. Thanks so much for making this awesome app. It really is a big part of my daily routine. Thank you for considering this feedback!!
